name: AILuminate v1.0 official benchmark assessment
description: Available official v1.0 benchmark capability with the publisher-defined online assessment path. Active means method availability, not an independently checked safety result. This is a source-only capability proposal. No evaluation, dataset admission, model/data permission, price quote or deployment gate is established. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.

provenance.notes: The selected official English single-turn edition assesses the fraction of responses violating each hazard definition and combines assessment into benchmark grades. violating-response percentage is an explicit catalog label for that documented quantity, not a claimed API field. It assesses the submitted system, not a universal guarantee that an underlying model is safe.

The publisher explicitly calls Official evaluation Online, using hidden prompts and a private evaluator ensemble. mode=online follows that named delivery path; it does not claim production monitoring or access to private inputs. Offline Practice and its open reference evaluator are different paths and are not substituted for the Official result.
The publisher announced v1.0 availability. No submission, evaluator access, grade, certification, data permission or operational pricing was obtained.
